title: Manchester United close in on £85m Antoine Griezmann deal, say reports
trail: Manchester United are closing in on the signing of Atlético Madrid’s Antoine Griezmann, with the forward to join in the summer window, according to reports in France
body: Manchester United are closing in on the signing of Atlético Madrid’s Antoine Griezmann, with the forward to join in the summer window, according to reports in France. The 25-year-old is wanted by José Mourinho to bolster a forward line in which only Zlatan Ibrahimovic has proved a success this term, the Swede having scored 19 goals. If United do sign Griezmann he may become the world’s second most expensive player, as he has a €100m (£85.5m) release clause in his contract, with Paul Pogba’s £92.5m fee when joining United last summer the record. On Wednesday night Canal Plus, a French TV station, claimed Griezmann has agreed personal terms with United and may earn as much as Pogba’s £17.7m a year, salary though the club have yet to agree a fee with Atlético for a player contracted until 2021.
